# Quiver compatibility references

Pinned repository: https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher
Revision: `a27f9a7b1f8d188dc693aff9a6567a7d5101ab95` (reviewed 2026-10-25).

Marquee uses an original Rust importer for the documented `apps` JSON format.
`Services/AppCatalogService.cs`, `Models/GameInfo.cs`, the app-list README and
`PlatformAssetMatcher.cs` were reviewed as schema/design references. No C# code,
upstream binary, logo, icon, hosted catalogue or project identifiers are bundled.
The root MIT notice and separately licensed core MIT notice are retained here.
No third-party dependency from Quiver is introduced. Quiver is a format reference,
not Marquee's application name or an endorsement.

Sources: [root license](https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher/blob/a27f9a7b1f8d188dc693aff9a6567a7d5101ab95/LICENSE),
[core license](https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher/blob/a27f9a7b1f8d188dc693aff9a6567a7d5101ab95/lib/QuiverLauncher.Core/LICENSE),
[branding](https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher/blob/a27f9a7b1f8d188dc693aff9a6567a7d5101ab95/TRADEMARKS.md).
